bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and any bag larger than a handbag or briefcase are not allowed at Place Bell. All guests are searched at entry.
prohibited: Bags larger than a handbag or briefcase
bagPolicy.note: Policy as posted on the Montreal Victoire (PWHL) game-day FAQ, which cites the security directives in place at Place Bell. Place Bell's own FAQ did not load. Prohibited bags cannot be left at the coat check. Searches can slow entry, so arrive early.

parking.summary: Place Bell lists indoor and outdoor parking around the arena and is next to Montmorency métro station.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Place Bell. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Restaurant and quick-service concession counters operate in the arena; menus vary by event.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The arena has an official accessibility guide covering mobility assistance and guest facilities.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once you go through the security check, you can't leave and re-enter.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is at the entrance and takes debit or credit cards (Visa, Visa Debit, MasterCard, American Express). Only the cardholder can buy with a credit card, so bring valid photo ID.

gates.summary: The venue publishes an official security guide for entry and the particular event page controls door times.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
